title: NestJS GraphQL Application Structure
abstract: File-placement and anatomy guide for NestJS GraphQL applications, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Teaches where every file belongs in a feature-first, code-first codebase — the base structure map plus per-file rules for modules, services, resolvers (query, mutation, subscription, and field), inputs and args, pagination, entities, models/mappers, repositories, providers, loaders, events, background jobs, auth, exceptions, custom scalars, config, common building blocks, GraphQL and database infrastructure, seeds, interfaces/tokens, unions/interfaces, and conventions (naming, barrels/aliases, lint boundaries, test placement, and fixtures) — each with purpose, responsibilities, and incorrect-vs-correct examples. It also covers how modules connect to resolve GraphQL fields and relations, including module-resolution concerns such as circular dependencies, while deferring behavioral concerns to the nestjs-best-practices skill.
